title: Fancyzones hold shift to activate while dragging disabling shift when typing normally
summary: After enabling FancyZones Shift-drag activation on PowerToys 0.99.1, the reporter says Shift no longer types capital letters normally.

judgment.rationale: Current FancyZones code samples Shift state and includes a guard intended not to swallow Shift+other-key combinations. The symptom could involve key-state transitions during or after a drag, but the report does not say whether it occurs outside a drag. Reproduce those states before changing the hook.
evidence: The report says Shift-drag-to-activate was enabled after upgrading to PowerToys 0.99.1.
The reporter says ordinary Shift capitalization stopped working while the setting was active.
No discussion clarifies whether Shift works when the setting is disabled or whether a drag is required.
judgment.recommended_action: Run the concrete before/after-drag typing comparison before selecting a hook change.

fix_assessment.rationale: This is an applicable keyboard input regression if reproduced; concrete maintainer repro should isolate typing outside versus after a drag.

reproduce.title: Preserve ordinary Shift typing with FancyZones Shift-drag activation
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported PowerToys 0.99.1; compare with current stable build
prerequisites: A text field and an ordinary draggable window
setup: Enable Hold Shift while dragging to activate zones.
steps: 1. Type uppercase letters in a text field without dragging.
2. Drag a window while holding Shift to activate zones; release the drag, then type uppercase letters again.
3. Disable the setting and repeat both typing checks as a control.
reproduce.expected_result: Shift remains available for ordinary typing before and after the drag; only intended drag activation behavior changes.
